principle: Do not buy research-grade options data until a cheaper signal-level gate survives; do not claim executable options edge without quote-level execution evidence.

stages.preferredOption: ThetaData Standard when 8-year tick/chain history is adequate and local terminal deployment is acceptable
stages.alternative: Massive Advanced when cloud-native historical quote access is preferred

stopSpendRules: If a setup fails the cheaper directional bootstrap, close that version before paid options replay.
If minute-options replay is negative under conservative fills, do not purchase quote-level history for that setup version.
Any paid data upgrade requires an alive setup and explicit owner approval.
